title: Wrong Number
synopsis: A voice on the line says, 'You weren't supposed to pick up.'

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
You commit to “Decline.” The story records the instinct as “Wise” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: Calm, female, careful. She asks if you can keep a secret.

choices.consequence: The decision settles the question for now. Its verdict—Honest—follows you into whatever comes next.
The choice lands, and the scene changes around it. If it has a name, that name is Wise.

nodes.text: She gives you an address. A bus station. Locker 47.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Path.
You commit to “Repeat it back skeptically.” The story records the instinct as “Smart” and carries it forward.

nodes.text: You go in the morning. There's a phone in the locker. It rings.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Brave.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Wise.

nodes.text: She is in danger. She needs you to mail an envelope.

choices.consequence: You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honor.
“Open it first” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Foolish.

nodes.text: You drop it in the box. A week later, a news story. A man indicted.

choices.consequence: You commit to “Note the story.” The story records the instinct as “Witness” and carries it forward.
You let the choice stand. The path shifts almost imperceptibly, marked by one lasting impulse: Honest.

nodes.text: Your envelope was, the story implies, the key piece. Nobody ever knows it was you.
She finds you. She buys you coffee. She does not, you notice, tell you her real name. You don't mind.
